explication: Kite Ground Control is a cross-platform ground station for INAV, ArduPilot, and PX4. A pilot uses the Svelte interface to connect to an aircraft, view and act on telemetry, plan missions, and control the vehicle; the Rust/Tauri backend handles links, autopilot protocols, and domain services. Major companion capabilities include flight logging, safety and airspace tools, radar, video, terrain awareness, and telemetry relay. The README documents these product relationships; source excerpts show selected backend and Android internals, so unsampled implementation links are not asserted.
